rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone or something is simply old, especially a person.

example.english: That aged man goes for a walk in the park every day.
example.traditional: 嗰個老伯伯每日都去公園行吓。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 lou5 baak3 baak3 mui5 jat6 dou1 heoi3 gung1 jyun4 haang4 haa5

rows.note: Use this for food or drink deliberately matured over time, such as aged whiskey, rather than merely being old.

example.english: This aged whisky is really fragrant.
example.traditional: 呢支陳年威士忌真係香。
example.jyutping: ni1 zi1 can4 nin4 wai1 si6 gei2 zan1 hai6 hoeng1
